# Inventor Design Studio (IDS)

> Leading creative technology studio bridging software development, UI/UX design, visual storytelling, and video production.

Website: https://inventordesignstudio.io
Contact: info@inventerdesignstudio.com
Phone: +92 370 4441788
HQ: First Floor, Plaza No. 8, H, A4, Commercial Area Block H Valencia, Lahore, 54000

## Core Capabilities & Services

1. **Software Development & Engineering**
   - Full-stack web platforms, SaaS architecture, React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript.
   - High-throughput APIs, cloud infrastructure, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), AWS/GCP DevOps.

2. **UI/UX & Product Design**
   - User research, wireframing, interactive prototyping in Figma, design systems, and accessible design.
   - Mobile and responsive digital interfaces with seamless user journeys.

3. **Cinematic Video Production & Motion Design**
   - 4K commercial films, corporate brand documentaries, drone videography, VFX, and post-production color grading.
   - High-engagement vertical video content and social media reels.

4. **Branding & Visual Identity**
   - Distinctive brand strategy, typography, iconography, and multi-channel brand guideline systems.
